verses.text: For the music director. By David. For remembrance. Hurry, God, to rescue me. Come quickly to help me, LORD.
Let those who want to take my life be put to shame and confusion. Turn back in disgrace those who want to see me ruined.
Let the ones who say, “Aha! Aha!” turn away in shame.
Let all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation keep saying, “Let God be exalted!”
I’m poor and needy. Come quickly, God. You’re my help and my rescuer. LORD, don’t delay.
